title: Regular Expression Matching
description:
Decide whether the entire string s matches the pattern p. A lowercase letter matches itself; a dot (.) matches exactly one lowercase letter. A star (*) applies only to the immediately preceding letter or dot and permits zero or more copies of it.

A match must cover the whole string, not merely a substring. The pattern is always well formed: a star never occurs first or immediately after another star. A starred atom can be ignored or used repeatedly; no other regular-expression features are supported.

Example 1:

Input: s = "aab", p = "c*a*b"
Output: true

Use zero c characters, two a characters, then b.

Example 2:

Input: s = "ab", p = ".*"
Output: true

Dot-star can consume both letters.

Example 3:

Input: s = "abc", p = "a.c"
Output: true

The dot consumes b between the a and c.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= s.length <= 30
  • 0 <= p.length <= 30
  • s contains only lowercase English letters.
  • p contains lowercase English letters, dots, and well-formed stars.
